Predicates:
Cost(test, 205) ::: It costs US $205 to take the GRE test.
Provides(ets, financialAid, greApplicants) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those GRE applicants who prove economic hardship.
EconomicHardship(x) ::: x experiences economic hardship, defined as difficulty caused by having too little money or too few resources.
SingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
OutOfWork(x, duration) ::: x has been out of work for duration.
AppliesFor(x, financialAid) ::: x can apply for financial aid from ETS to take the GRE test.
Premises:
Cost(greTest, 205) ::: It costs US $205 to take the GRE test.
∀x (EconomicHardship(x) → Provides(ets, financialAid, x)) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those GRE applicants who prove economic hardship.
EconomicHardship(x) ↔ (∃y (TooLittleMoney(y) ∨ TooFewResources(y))) ::: Economic hardship refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or too few resources.
SingleParentFamily(tom) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
OutOfWork(dadOf(tom), moreThanOneYear) ::: His dad has been out of work for more than a year.
Conclusion:
AppliesFor(tom, financialAid) ::: Tom can apply for financial aid from ETS to take the GRE test.
